home.progressNote: Progress tracking arrives in M1 (accounts). This is the M0 skeleton preview.
home.assessBody: 10–15 questions (finance + programming + interests) recommend your starting level. Coming in M1.

learn.title: Learning
learn.subtitle: Three parallel tracks — not a prerequisite chain. Order is guided by the Level system on the learning map.
learn.tradingDesc: From reading quotes, order books and trading apps to simulated trading, strategy tuning, and an overview of automated & high-frequency trading systems.
learn.researchDesc: From what factor mining is, through the math and finance basics, to a full classic-factor workflow, paper replication and competitions.
learn.codeDesc: Hands-on Python & pandas with auto-graded assignments — everything in-site, no external links.

trading.title: Trading Track
trading.subtitle: Five stages: Stages 1–4 form the main line (each gated by the previous quiz); Stage 5 is a knowledge extension.

research.title: Research Track
research.subtitle: Five layers: from concept to a complete workflow, then paper replication and competition exits.

code.title: Coding Track
code.subtitle: 8 lessons covering L1–L3. Step-by-step courses with auto-graded assignments, fully in-site.

assignments.title: Assignments & Practice
assignments.subtitle: Shared across all tracks: submissions, auto-grading, and a mistake notebook.
assignments.colSubmitDesc: Submit code assignments in the browser; hidden test cases judge instantly; unlimited retries.
assignments.colJudgeDesc: Code tasks run tests in-browser (Pyodide); concept quizzes are graded instantly.
assignments.colWrongDesc: Wrong answers are collected automatically with links back to the relevant sections.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.subtitle: Simulated trading (historical replay) and learning-point rankings.
